title: Build Hard-Challenger Lifecycle Specificity Evidence
objective: Measure whether the Task 190 surface-resolved lifecycle signature is specific to Task 183 counter-increment anchors when compared with replay-sourced structural hard challengers, without final death facts or attribution.

executionContract.reasoningComplexity: High: the task must construct replay-sourced structural challengers without labeling them as non-deaths, preserve Task 190 integrity and independently test specificity under matched follow-up.
executionContract.objective: Build pilot and bounded-32 hard-challenger lifecycle specificity evidence that distinguishes Task 183 anchors from structurally similar non-anchor transition clusters without emitting final facts.
technicalContext: Task 190 produced 2,552 exact pairs with a 30-second anchor/control lifecycle difference of 0.906471, but its controls are ordinary matched non-anchor times rather than structural hard challengers.
Only 12/32 replays met local strong criteria because local eligibility was often below 0.90; anchor rates, control rates and paired differences otherwise remained strong.
Upstream deadem v3.3.0 adds string-table, modifier and mutation-access APIs but no death confirmation or lifecycle-specificity solution.
confirmedState: Task 191 and commit aa8e18fa3c912c6d59f3125084e30a520e6b8f77 are Work-accepted locally with an external publication blocker.
Task 190 remains the active surface-resolved lifecycle evidence baseline with a partial operational assessment.
Final deaths, confirmed who-died claims, attribution, killer/victim, teamfight and gameplay interpretation remain unavailable.
The rejected Task 191 commit bf5cdaaa20c41b73523b53ea2855ca41c6223653 cannot be used as a base.
branchEnvironment: Create exactly one Task 192 commit locally; push only to origin/task191-correction when externally verified write access exists, never force-push or modify origin/main.
allowedScope: Add the Task 192 challenger contract, schema, emitter, focused tests, task/report, bounded artifacts and required navigation/state updates.
Process only the existing Task 190 pilot and bounded-32 human replay manifests through existing parser surfaces.
protectedAreas: Do not modify packages/deadem, packages/engine, samples, parser internals, Task 180-191 historical outputs or the accepted Task 190 baseline.
Do not read, hash, copy, inspect, open or process replay_005, replay_006, replay_007 or replay_008.
Do not call structural challengers non-deaths, false deaths, confirmed negatives or ground truth.
expectedChanges: Define challenger eligibility from replay-sourced forward-direction transition clusters outside every Task 183 anchor exclusion window.
Match anchors to challengers by replay, synthetic participant, time stratum, available common follow-up and observable surface opportunity with fresh per-horizon ledgers.
Emit pilot and bounded-32 specificity, eligibility, truncation, surface, ambiguity, reuse and sensitivity evidence without raw values or final facts.
acceptanceCriteria: Every challenger is replay-sourced, structurally eligible, outside anchor windows and described only as an unconfirmed structural challenger.
No anchor, challenger event, observation or assignment is reused within a cohort/horizon; matching and denominators are independently recomputed for 10, 20, 30, 60, 120 and 180 seconds.
Pilot and bounded-32 publish atomically with strict schema plus semantic invariant validation and explicit insufficient/partial/strong specificity assessment.
The result distinguishes specificity to Task 183 anchors from death truth and keeps every final-fact and attribution capability false.
requiredEvidence: Pre-open bridges to Tasks 180, 182, 183, 186 and 190; exact manifest membership; challenger exclusion-window audit; matching ledgers; per-replay and aggregate assessments.
Post-commit attestation with real SHA, base, branch, commits, files, tests, artifacts, limitations, push evidence and final VALIDATING status.
commitPolicy: Preserve the Work-authored coordination-state and Task 192 spec changes, stage only authorized files and create exactly one commit.
Do not amend Task 191, use the rejected commit as an ancestor, modify origin/main or claim a push without live remote SHA verification.
stopConditions: Stop before replay access on any provenance, manifest, membership, base, branch, protection or accepted-state mismatch.

Stop if challengers cannot be separated from Task 183 anchor windows without semantic guessing, if ground-truth negative labels would be required, or if source reuse/denominator integrity cannot be guaranteed.
Stop on protected replay access, parser/package modification, historical output mutation, unexpected output warning or more than one commit.
returnReportFormat: Use every section in docs/codex/CODEX_REPORT_TEMPLATE.md and attach the post-commit attestation.
Report technical gate and operational specificity assessment separately; final acceptance remains pending independent ChatGPT Work validation.

stopConditions: Never label a structural challenger as a confirmed non-death or negative ground truth.
Do not modify parser packages, Task 190 outputs, origin/main or create Task 193.
Stop after the Task 192 handoff in VALIDATING.
